text: # API Key Management ## Rotating API Keys To rotate an API key, generate a new key from the dashboard under Settings > API Keys > Generate New Key. Update your deployment's environment variable with the new key value. Both the old and new key remain valid for 24 hours to allow a safe cutover between them. After confirming the new key works in production, revoke the old key from the same dashboard page. ## Key Storage Store API keys in environment variables or a secrets manager, never in source control. Each key is scoped to a single project and can be revoked independently without affecting other projects. ## Emergency Revocation If a key is compromised, revoke it immediately from the dashboard -- this takes effect within seconds, without the usual 24-hour grace period that a routine rotation gets.
